lines.en: label cafesugar:
scene cafe_day
: Next customer!
lines.zh: : 下一位顾客！

lines.en: scene cafe1
: Oh! Morning, Sensei! What'll you be having today?
lines.zh: : 哦！早上好，老师！今天要点什么？

lines.en: : Rin, why do you even bother taking my order if you're just going to give me some random concoction instead?
lines.zh: : Rin，既然你最后端上来的都是随便调的东西，那你干嘛还要费心问我点什么？

lines.en: scene cafe2
: Hey, it won't be random! I put a lot of thought and love into the drinks I make.
lines.zh: : 嘿，才不是随便调的！我做的每一杯都倾注了很多心思和爱。

lines.en: : Then I guess I will order one cup of thought and love, please.
lines.zh: : 那我要一杯「心思和爱」，谢谢。

lines.en: scene cafe4
: Excellent choice, Sensei! I’ve got a really good one for you today, I swear.
lines.zh: : 好眼光，老师！今天我给你准备了一杯特别好的，我发誓。

lines.en: : They've all been good so I guess I'll just, once again, trust the judgement of the self-proclaimed best barista ever.
lines.zh: : 每一杯都很好，所以我想我就再一次相信这位「自称史上最强咖啡师」的判断吧。

lines.en: : Nuh-uh-uh. It's not just self-proclaimed anymore since you wrote it on a card. Now, there is written proof that I am the best barista ever.
lines.zh: : 不不不。现在已经不是「自称」了，因为你把它写在卡片上了。现在有书面证据证明我就是史上最强咖啡师。

lines.en: : I don't think I'm really fit to be making the final decision on that, but I'm glad you're happy.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我没什么资格做最终裁定，不过你开心就好。

lines.en: : So, what's so different about today's drink?
lines.zh: : 那今天的饮料有什么特别的？

lines.en: scene cafe1
: The one today is made with {i}extra{/i} love.
lines.zh: : 今天这杯加了{i}额外的{/i}爱。

lines.en: : Can I have extra {i}thought{/i} instead? Love is a little too sweet for me.
lines.zh: : 那能改成多加{i}心思{/i}吗？爱对我来说有点太甜了。

lines.en: : No. Because love tastes like vanilla and we ordered extra vanilla syrup that I am now responsible for getting rid of.
lines.zh: : 不行。因为爱尝起来是香草味，而我们多进了一批香草糖浆，现在得由我负责把它们消耗掉。

lines.en: : There's no actual love in this drink at all, is there?
lines.zh: : 所以这杯里根本就没有真正的爱，对吧？

lines.en: scene cafe4
: There is love in {i}everything{/i} I make for you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我为你做的{i}每一样东西{/i}里都有爱，老师。

lines.en: : The barista isn't the one who's supposed to initiate the flirting. I think there's some sort of code against that.
lines.zh: : 咖啡师不该是主动调情的那个人。我觉得这算是违反某种守则吧。

lines.en: : There's a code against a lot of things. But then there are cheat codes that let you ignore them.
lines.zh: : 守则管的东西多着呢。不过还有作弊码，可以让你无视它们。

lines.en: : My love is but one more bug in the system. A bug that just happens to taste like vanilla.
lines.zh: : 我的爱不过是系统里多出来的一个 bug。一个刚好尝起来是香草味的 bug。

lines.en: : Well, I'm glad that you've at least confirmed it won't be anything with the potential to kill me.
lines.zh: : 行吧，至少你确认了它不会有弄死我的潜力，我很欣慰。

lines.en: scene cafe3
: Kill you? Of course not. If you die, who will I have to experiment on?
lines.zh: : 弄死你？当然不会。你要是死了，我拿谁做实验？

lines.en: : Is your need for a guinea pig all that is keeping me tethered to this world?
lines.zh: : 所以把我拴在这个世界上的，就只有你对小白鼠的需求？

lines.en: scene cafe1
: Probably. So it would be in your best interest if you'd just leave all this stuff to me and go take a seat while I pour you a nice cup of love.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。所以你最好把这些事都交给我，自己去找个座位坐下，我给你倒一杯香浓的爱。

lines.en: : With maybe a {i}little{/i} bit of arsenic for added flavor.
lines.zh: : 再加点{i}少许{/i}砒霜提提味。

lines.en: : Is your manager around? I'd like to inquire about a refund.
lines.zh: : 你们店长在吗？我想问问能不能退款。

lines.en: : Sorry, no returns. Tough luck.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，概不退换。算你倒霉。

lines.en: scene black
I sigh to myself and slide a 500 yen coin across the counter to Rin, who picks it up and shoots it into a register like it's a basketball.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，把一枚 500 日元硬币滑过柜台递给 Rin；她拿起硬币，像投篮球一样把它射向收银机。

lines.en: Unfortunately, she does not appear to be very good at basketball as she misses completely and it bounces off the counter and right back over to me.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，她似乎并不太擅长篮球——她完全没投中，硬币撞在柜台上弹了回来，正好回到我面前。

lines.en: But, being the gentleman I am, I give her the money {i}again{/i} and go to find a table as she starts preparing my drink.
lines.zh: 不过，作为一位绅士，我{i}又{/i}把钱给了她一次，然后去找位子坐下，她则开始准备我的饮料。

lines.en: scene sugarredux1
: Alrighty, here you go. I brought some extra pastries and stuff too.
lines.zh: : 好啦，给你。我还多带了些点心什么的。

lines.en: : I...see that. Not like I care, but is it really okay for you to be taking this much stuff from work?
lines.zh: : 我……看到了。我倒不是在意，不过你从店里拿这么多东西真的没问题吗？

lines.en: : Totes. All this stuff needs to get thrown out anyway since we can't hold stuff for more than two days.
lines.zh: : 完全没问题。反正这些东西都得扔掉，我们不能把存货放超过两天。

lines.en: : Well, thank you very much for the expired pastries.
lines.zh: : 那真是非常感谢你的过期点心。

lines.en: I take a sip of the drink Rin slid across the counter to me and, just like always, it's...good.
lines.zh: 我抿了一口 Rin 推过柜台递给我的饮料，和往常一样……还不错。

lines.en: A bit on the sugary side due to the amount of {i}love{/i} in it, but still good.
lines.zh: 因为{i}爱{/i}放得多，甜得有点过，但还是好喝。

lines.en: : I give it a seven out of ten.
lines.zh: : 我给七分，满分十分。

lines.en: scene sugarredux2
: Wait, a seven?! That's it?!
lines.zh: : 等等，七分？！就这样？！

lines.en: : But I put so much love into it!
lines.zh: : 可我放了那么多爱进去啊！

lines.en: : I think that's exactly the problem. All I can taste is the love.
lines.zh: : 我觉得问题就在这儿。我满嘴尝到的全是爱。

lines.en: : But the love is good! The love is great! Love the love, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 可这份爱很好啊！棒极了！爱这份爱吧，老师！

lines.en: : Do you want to give it a try? Because I'm fine for now, but I have no idea if I'll be able to drink the whole thing.
lines.zh: : 你要不要自己尝尝？我现在还撑得住，但我不知道自己能不能喝完这一整杯。

lines.en: : Is it really that sweet?
lines.zh: : 真的有那么甜吗？

lines.en: : Shouldn't you be testing things before handing them off to me?
lines.zh: : 你不该在递给我之前自己先试一下吗？

lines.en: : Do scientists test chemicals on themselves before pumping rodents full of them, Sensei? You are my guinea pig for a reason.
lines.zh: : 科学家在往老鼠体内灌化学药剂之前，会先在自己身上试吗，老师？你是我的小白鼠，这不是没有原因的。

lines.en: : As the person responsible for establishing the footing of your new drink platform, you should really value me more.
lines.zh: : 作为帮你打下新饮品平台基础的人，你真该更重视我一点。

lines.en: scene sugarredux3
Rin looks down at my mug for a few seconds, contemplating whether or not she wants to become a rodent of her own, before sighing to herself and admitting defeat.
lines.zh: Rin 低头盯着我的杯子看了几秒钟，思考着自己要不要也当一回老鼠，随后暗自叹了口气，认输了。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. I'll take your word. Some people are really into the super sugary stuff, though.
lines.zh: : 好吧，行。我听你的。不过确实有人就喜欢那种超甜的东西。

lines.en: : Like, we get customers all the time who order coffee and then proceed to dump like, 50%% of it out and fill the rest with cream and sugar.
lines.zh: : 比如我们经常遇到客人点了咖啡，然后倒掉差不多 50%%，剩下的全用奶油和糖填满。

lines.en: : That's not even coffee at that point.
lines.zh: : 到那个地步，那根本就不算咖啡了。

lines.en: scene sugarredux4
: I know! Like, why are you even ordering coffee if you don't like the taste of coffee? Do you just like the {i}idea{/i} of coffee? Do you think it will make people like you or something?
lines.zh: : 就是说啊！你不喜欢咖啡的味道，为什么还要点咖啡？你只是喜欢咖啡的{i}概念{/i}吗？还是觉得这样能让别人喜欢你？

lines.en: : I don't get it. Especially those customers who are like...{i}umm...the place near my house uses extra syrup.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我真不懂。尤其是那种客人，说什么……{i}嗯……我家附近那家会多放糖浆。{/i}

lines.en: : Like, whoopdy-fucking-do, Karen. Why not just go there instead if you like them so much?
lines.zh: : 哦，真是他妈的了不起呢，Karen。既然你那么喜欢，干嘛不干脆去那边？

lines.en: scene sugarredux5
: I'm gonna punch somebody in the face one day, Sensei. I just know it.
lines.zh: : 老师，我总有一天会一拳揍在别人脸上。我有预感。

lines.en: : Is it really okay to be saying things like that while you're still in uniform?
lines.zh: : 你还穿着制服呢，说这种话真的好吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I clocked out for my break so it's no big deal.
lines.zh: : 没事，我已经打卡休息了，所以没关系的。

lines.en: : I get what you're saying about the less sugar thing, though. I guess my mind was just tainted by all of the customers with shittier tastebuds than yours.
lines.zh: : 不过你说的少放糖那点我懂。我想我的脑子是被那些味觉比你烂得多的客人给带坏了。

lines.en: : Anyway, rant over. Let's order pizza.
lines.zh: : 总之，抱怨结束。我们点披萨吧。

lines.en: : You sure you're done? Because it looked like you were enjoying yourself just now.
lines.zh: : 你确定说完了？刚才你看起来挺乐在其中的。

lines.en: : It almost might be good to find out if there is anything that I, as a customer, should be doing to avoid invoking your wrath.
lines.zh: : 我倒是挺想知道，作为一个顾客，我该做点什么才能免遭你的雷霆之怒。

lines.en: scene sugarredux6
: You’re fine, Sensei. I like you as a customer.
lines.zh: : 你没问题，老师。我喜欢你这样的顾客。

lines.en: : That’s just because I let you experiment on me.
lines.zh: : 那只是因为我让你拿我做实验。

lines.en: : The experimenting part definitely helps. But even without that, I'd like you.
lines.zh: : 能做实验确实加分。但就算不做实验，我也会喜欢你。

lines.en: : I think you're breaking the flirting code again, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你又在违反调情守则了，Rin。

lines.en: scene sugarredux7
: This isn't flirting! I seriously do.
lines.zh: : 这不是调情！我是认真的。

lines.en: : We get a lot of customers in here and I'm never really {i}excited{/i} to deal with any of them.
lines.zh: : 我们店里客人很多，可我对他们中的任何一个都{i}提不起劲{/i}。

lines.en: : But with you, it's like...not like that.
lines.zh: : 但换成你，就……不是那样。

lines.en: : I don't know. It's hard to explain. But I'm going to ask that you keep showing up whenever possible as it definitely makes my mornings a little better.
lines.zh: : 我也说不清。很难解释。但我想请你尽可能地常来，因为这确实让我的早晨好过了一点。

lines.en: scene sugarredux8
: But, now that I've gotten that embarrassing piece of information out of the way, I should probably be getting back to work.
lines.zh: : 不过，既然已经把这么难为情的话说出口了，我大概也该回去干活了。

lines.en: : Already? But you just clocked out for your break a few minutes ago, didn't you?
lines.zh: : 已经要走了？可你几分钟前才打卡休息的吧？

lines.en: scene sugarredux6
: Yeah. I get a few breaks because of labor laws and stuff like that, though. What you just experienced was one of the short ones.
lines.zh: : 是啊。不过因为劳动法之类的规定，我有好几次休息。你刚才经历的是其中最短的那种。

lines.en: : But hey, time your visits better and you might be able to catch me on a full-length break one day.
lines.zh: : 不过嘛，你要是把来的时间掐准点，说不定哪天就能碰上我的一次完整休息。

lines.en: : I'll do my best. Sorry your entire mini-break was wasted on me.
lines.zh: : 我尽量。抱歉你整个小憩都浪费在我身上了。

lines.en: : It's not a waste at all.
lines.zh: : 那根本不算浪费。

lines.en: : Do you want an actual drink now? Or are you going to force yourself to finish that one for my sake?
lines.zh: : 你现在想来杯正常的饮料吗？还是说你打算为了我硬着头皮把那杯喝完？

lines.en: : The plan was to tell you I'd finish this so I could look cool, then drop it into a trash can a few blocks away from here.
lines.zh: : 我本来打算跟你说我会喝完，好显得自己很酷，然后走到几个街区外把它扔进垃圾桶。

lines.en: : Now that I know a replacement is possible, I will graciously accept.
lines.zh: : 既然知道还能换一杯，我就恭敬不如从命了。

lines.en: : Roger that. But, just so you know, it's gonna be another patented Rin Rokuhara creation.
lines.zh: : 收到。不过先说好，这杯还是会出自 Rin Rokuhara 的独家专利配方。

lines.en: : Easy on the love this time.
lines.zh: : 这次爱少放点。

lines.en: scene black
Rin steps away from the table before swiftly spinning around and skipping over to the counter, starting on my new drink as soon as she arrives.
lines.zh: Rin 从桌边走开，随即飞快地转过身，蹦跳着跑到柜台后，一到就立刻开始做我的新饮料。

lines.en: As is customary, another wave of customers crashes into the store and prevents the two of us from being able to actually say goodbye to one another-
lines.zh: 和往常一样，又一波客人涌进店里，害我们俩没能真正道别——

lines.en: But I do get my replacement drink.
lines.zh: 但我确实拿到了替换的那杯。

lines.en: And go figure, but it's much more enjoyable without all of the love.
lines.zh: 说来也怪，没了那么多爱，它反而好喝多了。

lines.en: $ cafesugar = True
$ rin_love += 1
{i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
